g.text: Notes: File reads count successful reads of another agent's notes or measurement records, including repeated reads. Direct Python reads are

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; fill: #18181b

g.text: not recorded, so these counts could understate the actual extent of file reading. Panel B counts responses mentioning other agents or peers,

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; fill: #18181b

g.text: either in generic terms or explicitly by ID, in generated text, generated file content, or available reasoning summaries. Panel C counts the subset

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; fill: #18181b

g.text: mentioning a specific other agent by its ID. I exclude supplied prompts and text returned by tools.
